svg.title: The method around the model
svg.desc: Timeline. 2006: Processbench, machine learning prices a part from its value drivers. 2018 and 2021: VDI 2817, the method becomes a German standard. Research: flow efficiency, doctoral research, online soon. Now: SupplyConnect, swappable language models under control loops.

svg.text: FROM STATISTICAL MODELS TO LANGUAGE MODELS
